newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH PARLIAMENT TO VOTE ON ENERGY LAW THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: POLISH PARLIAMENT TO VOTE ON ENERGY LAW THURSDAY.

text.p: Poland's lower house of parliament will hold a final vote on a draft of the crucial energy law on Thursday, the parliament's press office said.

During the bill's third reading, deputies will vote on 39 amendments, proposed at an earlier debate, most important of which would protect electricity producers against bankruptcy by granting them a special economic status.

The long-debated bill, which will have to clear the senate and be signed by the president, would introduce free market rules into the energy sector and pave the way for its privatisation. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
